jobs.title: (Senior) Creative Strategist - Social first (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Was Du Bei Uns Machen Wirst

Wie bringt man Menschen dazu, sich freiwillig mit ihrer Steuererklärung zu beschäftigen?
Genau das ist deine Aufgabe.

Als Creative Strategist Paid Social bei Zasta bringst du Leute, die beim Wort „Steuererklärung“ sofort weiterscrollen, dazu, anzuhalten, die App zu laden und loszulegen. Wie? Mit Ads auf TikTok und Instagram, die mutig, lustig und auch mal provokant sind. Hier darfst du dich richtig austoben.
Das Beste daran: Wir bauen gerade unsere Inhouse Agency auf, und du gestaltest sie von Grund auf mit, von Prozessen über Formate bis zur Arbeitsweise.
Du bekommst viel Freiraum für neue Creative Angles, testest, was wirklich funktioniert, und bringst große Ideen auch mal ins TV.

Deine Aufgaben

Paid Social ist dein Zuhause: Rund 80 % deiner Zeit drehen sich um Ads auf TikTok und Instagram. Du entwickelst laufend neue Ideen, Hooks und Formate und bringst sie schnell live.
Zielgruppe verstehen: Du weißt, was unsere Zielgruppe scrollt, teilt und kommentiert. Du erkennst Trends früh und machst daraus Creatives, die sich nicht wie Werbung anfühlen.
Ideen in Serie: Du machst auch langweilige Themen interessant. Steuer sind nicht unbedingt ein Scroll-Stopper. Deine Ads schon!"
Daten, Tests, Learnings: Du schaust täglich, was performt. Du testest Varianten gegeneinander und lässt jedes Learning direkt ins nächste Konzept fließen.
Eng im Team: Du bist die Brücke zwischen Performance Marketing, Data und Agenturen, also zwischen „Was sagen die Daten?“ und „Was machen wir jetzt Geiles daraus?“.
Und manchmal: TV. Auch das Fernsehen ist für uns ein wichtiger Kanal. Du entwickelst kreative Konzepte, mit denen wir neue Zielgruppen erschließen und unsere bestehenden Zielgruppen weiter ausbauen.
Produktion: Du begleitest die Produktion von Anfang bis Ende. Neben der Entwicklung deiner Konzepte bist du bei den Drehs dabei und führst Regie. Mit deinem Feedback zu den fertigen Assets sorgst du am Ende dafür, dass Konzept, Tonalität und Umsetzung stimmen

Was Du Idealerweise Mitbringst

Fundierte Erfahrung in Creative Strategy, Concepting oder Kampagnenentwicklung, idealerweise im digitalen Performance-Umfeld.
Du lebst Paid Social und hast nachweislich erfolgreiche Creatives für TikTok und Instagram entwickelt. Ein Portfolio zeigst du gern.
Du kennst den Meta und Tik Tok Ads Manager und übersetzt Daten, Insights und Zielgruppenpsychologie in Ideen, die Leads bringen.
Du bist immer on top of Social-Trends und denkst in Umsetzung statt in Slides: lieber heute drei Ideen live als nächsten Monat eine perfekte.
Deutsch auf mindestens C1-Niveau, sicher mit englischen Marketing-Begriffen.
TV-Erfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss.

Was Wir Dir Bieten

Wir sind ein profitables Unternehmen, das nachhaltig wächst. Unser Management kennt jeden, der bei uns arbeitet.
Mit Büros in Rostock und Berlin kannst du frische Seeluft schnuppern oder dich vom Großstadtdschungel mitreißen lassen. Regelmäßige Besuche und Team-Events sorgen für das Gemeinschaftsgefühl.
Je nach Standort treffen wir uns an zwei Tagen die Woche vor Ort im Büro - dienstags und mittwochs in Rostock und mittwochs und donnerstags in Berlin. Die restlichen Tage kannst du dir aussuchen, von wo aus du arbeitest. Falls du an den Präsenztagen mal nicht ins Büro kommen kannst, gibt es Jokertage, die du flexibel einsetzen kannst.
Tapetenwechsel inklusive - bei Zasta hast du 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr und die Möglichkeit, bis zu 4 Wochen am Stück innerhalb Europas zu arbeiten.

Du bist dir nicht sicher, ob du alle Anforderungen für diese Stelle erfüllst? Wir freuen uns trotzdem über deine Bewerbung. Vielleicht bringst du etwas Besonderes in das Team ein, das wir bisher nicht in Betracht gezogen haben.

Dein Kontakt Bei Zasta

Wenn du Fragen zur Stelle hast, kannst du uns jederzeit über jobs@zasta.de schreiben. Bewerbungen können wir nur online über die Plattform akzeptieren und werden auf anderem Wege nicht beachtet
. Wir freuen uns, von dir zu lesen!

Über uns
Zasta wurde 2017 gegründet und ist die führende Steuer-App in den deutschen App-Stores. Unsere Software ermöglicht es jedem Steuerzahler ohne großen Aufwand eine professionelle Steuererklärung einzureichen. Unsere Plattform arbeitet mit echten Steuerberatern zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass jeder das beste Ergebnis erhält - auch ohne Steuerwissen. Über 2 Millionen Nutzer vertrauen bereits in unsere App. Komm auch du mit auf unsere Reise, ein nerviges Finanzthema in einen freudigen Geldregen zu verwandeln.

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

WPP steht für kreative Transformation. Mit der Kraft von Kreativität gestalten wir eine bessere Zukunft für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kunden, unsere Gemeinschaften und unseren Planeten. Genau hier setzt WPP Media an: Als globales Mediennetzwerk von WPP vereinen wir die besten Plattformen, Talente und Partner, um in einer vernetzten Medienwelt neue Chancen für grenzenloses Wachstum zu schaffen.

Vacation mode on: Du erhältst 30 Urlaubstage plus einen flexiblen Tag – zusätzlich sind der 24. und 31.12. frei.
Wellbeing first: Gesundheitsleistungen, attraktive Altersvorsorge sowie Mental Health Awareness Days stellen deine Gesundheit in den Mittelpunkt.

More than just a job: Dich erwarten unvergessliche Events, Mitarbeitendenrabatte und weitere Highlights wie das Job Ticket, Wellhub oder das Job Bike.
Be yourself: Bei uns ist jede:r herzlich willkommen - Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit liegen uns am Herzen.

Das Bewegst Du

Als Senior Creative Concept (
Mensch)
bist du unser kreativer Kopf und übernimmst die inhaltliche Führung bei der Erstellung von Konzepten und Kampagnen. Dabei greifst du auf dein spezifisches Fachwissen aus den Bereichen Copywriting, Art Direction oder Konzeption zurück.

Kreation trifft Media: Dein Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung und Umsetzung kanalübergreifender Konzepte und kulturell relevanter Kampagnen. Diese erstellst du im Kontext der Mediaagentur passgenau mit Blick auf die Mediaplanung und stehst im engen Austausch mit deinen Kolleg:innen aus der Media.

Konzeptionelle Führung: Innerhalb deiner Projekte übernimmst du die ganzheitliche konzeptionelle Führung – von der initialen Idee bis zur finalen Umsetzung und sorgst auf diesem Weg für Konsistenz und Exzellenz im Output.

Kunden & Projekte: Du begleitest Projekte konzeptionell, arbeitest eng mit dem Projektmanagement zusammen und präsentierst Ideen professionell vor Kund:innen – auch bei Pitches und Reviews spielst du eine wichtige Rolle.

Das Zeichnet Dich Aus

Innovation Lead: Du liebst neue Trends, setzt dich regelmäßig mit KI auseinander, und hast Lust, Neues auszuprobieren und zu etablieren.
Dein Mindset: Du bist eigeninitiativ, verantwortungsbewusst, ein echter Teamplayer und arbeitest strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.

jobs.title: AI Designer & Creative Technologist
jobs.description:
Budapest

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

Job Purpose

This position sits in our Marketing & Technology service, working with our UK teams from Hungary. We combine data, technology, creative and paid media to crack brands’ business problems & drive revenue through a variety of digital marketing solutions like social, influencer, TTL ad campaigns, augmented reality, AI and innovation. Our clients include eBay, easyJet, Open Ai and Google.

We are looking for an AI Designer & Creative Technologist to join our creative team. The role has two halves: delivering AI-led creative work on live client projects, and building the tools and workflows that make the wider agency faster at it. The client work is varied, from fast-turnaround BAU creative responses to in-person creative sprints and full campaign productions across global markets, and generative AI now runs through most of it.

On the delivery side, you will take briefs from early thinking through to finished, client-ready work using generative image, video and audio tools alongside the Adobe suite, working with designers, motion designers, art directors and producers to make AI output on brand, consistent, and following legal specifications. On the technology side, you will spot the repetitive, manual parts of how our designers work and build things that remove them: automation pipelines, scripts, plugins and small internal tools.

This is a hands-on role and we are open to all levels of experience: what matters is the quality of your work and your judgement about when and how to use these tools. The scope of the role, from how much you lead to how much you guide others, will be shaped around the experience you bring. You will work day to day with creative directors, account teams and clients in the UK, mostly remotely, and contribute to creative sprints and workshops, in person where possible.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Turn creative briefs into AI-generated and AI-enhanced imagery, video and motion across social, paid, digital and campaign work
Build and refine prompts and workflows across image and video generation tools, keeping a library of what works per client
Finish AI output in Photoshop, After Effects and Premiere Pro so it sits seamlessly alongside photography, design and live action
Keep brand and character consistency across generated assets using references, style guides and custom models
Produce rapid concepts, styleframes and visual explorations to help teams pitch and iterate faster
Build repeatable AI workflows, prompt frameworks and best-practice documentation for the team
Spot repetitive, manual steps in how designers work and build tools that remove them: Adobe and Figma scripts and plugins, node-based pipelines, small browser utilities
Prototype and maintain internal tools with the people who use them, iterating on real feedback
Be a point of knowledge on AI for creative directors and account teams: what’s possible, what it costs in time and risk, how to pitch it
Own responsible use of AI on your work: client tool guidelines, data handling, IP and likeness, disclosure labelling and provenance metadata
Work with producers to scope AI-led deliverables accurately, flagging where AI isn’t the right route
Share what you build and learn through show-and-tells and training sessions
Present work internally and externally to an excellent standard
Stay close to new tools and models, testing them against real briefs and recommending what we adopt

WHAT YOU BRING:

A portfolio of AI-generated or AI-enhanced work finished to a professional standard, for brands, agencies or personal projects
Solid design fundamentals: composition, typography, colour and an eye for what looks right on screen
Hands-on experience building work in node-based AI workflows (e.g. Figma Weave, ComfyUI, Flora) that chain models like Flux, Veo, Kling and Sora with editing steps, and the judgement to pick the right model and route for the job
Strong Photoshop skills, with working After Effects and/or Premiere Pro to take output through to finish
Some ability to build as well as make: scripting or automation (e.g. Python, JavaScript, ExtendScript, Figma plugins, ComfyUI) used to speed up creative work
A problem-solver’s instinct for spotting inefficiency in a workflow and fixing it properly
Understanding of how social, paid and digital assets are specced and delivered (formats, safe zones, aspect ratios, versioning)
Awareness of the ethical, legal and brand-safety considerations around generative AI in commercial work
Fluent English, with confidence explaining your process and presenting to creative directors, account teams and clients
A willingness to share what you know and help others get better with these tools
Curious, experimental and self-directed when a tool or workflow doesn’t exist yet
Nice to have: motion, 3D or VFX background, custom model training, LLM APIs and agentic tooling, content provenance standards.

WE OFFER

Private health insurance and access to a range of healthcare and preventive services.
Sports & cultural benefits to support your wellbeing and work-life balance.
Dog-friendly office
Hybrid working policy
A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021.
Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.
Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHO ARE WE?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Lead (8+ years)
jobs.description:
Briefly about ourselves

Random is an experience design studio based in Amsterdam and Paris. Our work comes to life where the digital and the physical are fluid. We use technology in a human, tangible way and so invite people to connect to each other and the space they share.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a Senior Creative Lead who starts with the big question.

Before the space, before the technology, before any of it: what is this experience actually saying? What does this brand need to communicate, and what's the most compelling way to do that in a room, at an event, in a space someone walks into?

That's where this role begins. With a holistic communication concept a brand storytelling idea that gives a project its reason for being. From there, it translates into spatial decisions, interactive moments, technology choices. But those come second. The person we're looking for holds the full arc, from the strategic question down to the specific expression of it.

We would like you to think from brand strategy to communication to experiential execution. In practice, that means someone like this might challenge a client's underlying ambition, build a creative communication strategy for a launch, and define a high-level concept for how a space should behave all within the same project.

If your strongest work is brand campaign films or advertising concepts, this isn't the right role. If your interest lies in creating (spatial) brand experiences where you make people feel something, invite them to explore, make them wonder, then please read on.

Core responsibilities

Concept development: Lead the creative thinking on key projects from brief to concept. Write clear, strong debriefs that sharpen the question before anyone starts answering it. Develop brand storytelling ideas that are holistic not just a visual style, or just a content format, but an idea about what a brand experience should do and feel like and mean.

Creative direction across projects Translate concepts into creative direction for multi-disciplinary teams, spatial designers, creative technologists, motion designers, producers. Not by designing everything yourself, but by making sure the idea holds across every decision.

Client relationships Be the main creative voice with clients throughout a project. Present with clarity and conviction. Challenge briefs when they need challenging. Help clients understand the difference between an installation and an experience.

Team leadership Build and lead project teams, internal and freelance. Set creative standards, give useful feedback, create space for others to do good work. Lead by being present, specific and engaged —not a distant creative director.

New business contribution Contribute to pitches and proposals. Bring ideas to the table early in the process, when the thinking matters most.

What a concept means for us

We've learned to be specific about this because the word gets used to mean too many things.

A Concept In This Context Is Not

A sketch or a render
A visual identity direction
A campaign format or content type
A technology idea

A concept is a brand storytelling idea. It's the answer to the question: what is this experience about? The why. It can usually be expressed in a sentence or two. It generates decisions — about space, interaction, content, materiality, technology — rather than describing them.

The technology is a tool. The space is a medium. The concept is the reason any of it exists.

Your profile

8+ years of experience in creative roles within experiential, brand, or spatial work
A portfolio of idea-led projects where you can clearly articulate what the concept was, where it came from, and how it shaped the final work
Experience working across disciplines: spatial, digital, interactive, content
Comfortable at the strategic level able to read and challenge a brand brief, not just respond to it
Strong presenter and communicator, in rooms that matter
Experience leading teams and working with freelancers
Has worked with global brands in lifestyle, fashion, luxury, or sport
Based in or willing to relocate to Amsterdam or Paris

What we don't need more of

We've had talented people apply whose work is genuinely strong but in a different domain. To save everyone time:

This role is not well suited to people whose primary experience is in advertising, brand film, or content production. The thinking that makes someone good at a 30-second spot or a social campaign is different from what this role requires. Neither is better, they're just different.

What's missing, and what we're looking for, is someone who starts with an idea.

What success looks like

You bring a clear concept to every project, early one that the whole team can work from
Clients trust your creative judgment, not just your execution
The work feels like it has a point of view, not just a visual language
Teams you lead know what they're aiming at and why
You make the projects harder in the right ways, and easier in the wrong ones

Random Studio Diversity & Inclusion Statement

At Random Studio, we believe that an inclusive work environment and a diverse team are key to creating fresh and inspiring work. We’re looking for candidates who enrich our culture and challenge the status quo. We encourage everyone to bring their whole selves to work, and we strive to provide all candidates with an unbiased and accessible recruitment process. If you require assistance due to a disability when applying please let us know in your application so we can accommodate your needs.

jobs.description:
Creative Strategist (D2C / DTC) at NUTRICOOK — own every ad we run for a category-leading lifestyle kitchen appliance brand scaling its direct-to-consumer business.

Who we are

NutriCook is a leading home and kitchen appliance brand headquartered in Dubai, with a fast-growing D2C (DTC) business. We focus on healthy cooking: air fryers, pressure cookers, indoor grills, ovens, food prep and cookware.
We are a category leader across the Middle East, and in 2027 we launch into Europe, the UK, Southeast Asia and India. Our own direct-to-consumer channel is already a meaningful part of the business. Our objective is to multiply it, and creative is the single biggest lever we have.
We are a lean team. If you own something here, you genuinely own it.

Why this role exists

Our D2C business has a ceiling on it, and the ceiling is our ads. Not our product, not our traffic, not our agency's media buying. Our creative.
Too much of it is AI-generated and it looks like it. We don't produce enough of it. And nobody wakes up owning it. Look at what Caraway and IM8 put out: that is the bar. Ads built on a real insight about a real person, made properly, in enough volume to keep testing and keep winning.
You will not inherit a creative engine or a production setup. You are building it.

What this job is, and what it is not

·         You own the idea.
You decide what we say, to whom, and why it will make them stop and buy.
·         You direct, you do not edit.
You brief and manage creators and editors to produce the work.
·         You build the bench.
You find, brief and manage the creators, editors and freelancers who make the work.
·         You don't buy media.
Our agency runs the buying. You own what they run.
·         You don't make brand films.
This is direct response. Every ad has a job, and the job is to sell.
What you will do

·        Know our products and customers properly. Mine reviews, returns, support tickets and competitors' reviews for real objections and real moments of delight.
·        Build a hook library and a point of view on what we should say, backed by evidence, not taste.
·        Write tight briefs: hook, angle, objection, proof and format, before anything is shot.
·        Source, cast and direct UGC creators so the output is usable first time.
·        Ship a steady stream of genuinely new concepts, not recuts, and grow the active ad library to 200+.
·        Run structured tests with a stated hypothesis. Read hook rate, hold rate, CTR and CVR by creative. Kill fast, scale winners, build the next five variations.
·        Work with the agency on ROAS: they own the buying, you own the creative that makes it work.
·        Make sure landing pages deliver what the ad promises, and run simple CRO tests to lift conversion.

What we need from you

·        3+ years owning performance ad creative on Meta and TikTok for a D2C or DTC e-commerce brand, or at an agency serving them.
·        A portfolio of ads you personally conceived and briefed, with the insight, the test and the numbers behind them.
·        Hands-on experience briefing and directing UGC creators.
·        Fluency in creative performance data: hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CVR, cost per result. You can explain why an ad failed, not just that it did.
·        Strong writing: hooks, scripts, ad copy.
·        Proven volume: dozens of concepts a quarter, not a handful a year.
·        A bias for action. You chase the creator, fix the edit and get it live.

Nice to have

·        Home, kitchen, food or daily-use product experience
·        Smart use of AI tools as an accelerator, knowing where they stop being good enough
·        Arabic, or experience making creative for this region
·        Static and motion design literacy, enough to art-direct

This job is not for you if

·        Your ads have been made mostly by AI with light human direction.
·        You've run social content rather than direct-response ads for a DTC brand.
·        You need a creative director above you to decide the angle.
·        You brief an agency and leave them to it. Here you own the output, not the handover.

How we measure you

·         Yours alone:
new concepts shipped per month, active ad library on the path to 200+, hook and hold rate, CTR and CVR by creative, and win rate against control.
·         Shared with the agency:
ROAS and cost per acquisition.
·         The point of the role:
incremental D2C revenue growth.
What we offer

·        Full ownership of the creative behind a real, growing D2C business
·        A product people genuinely love, which makes the creative job easier and more fun
·        Real budget, real volume and direct access to leadership
·        Competitive salary, annual performance bonus, medical insurance, annual air ticket and UAE visa as per company policy

How to apply

1. Apply here on LinkedIn and answer the screening questions.
2. Within 48 hours, email three ads you personally conceived and briefed to hr@caliberbrands.com with the subject line "My Best Ad". Links, files or screen recordings are fine. For one of them, tell us the insight, what you were trying to prove, what it spent and what it returned.

We only review applications that include the ads. The ads matter more than the CV.

Our drones are reliable, user-friendly, and built to perform in demanding environments.

We combine technical innovation with a pragmatic mindset. What we do today shapes where we’ll be tomorrow, and you’ll play a crucial role in that journey.

Our core values

Partnerships
– Growing together through long-term collaboration
Customer focus
– Thinking and acting with the customer in mind
Ownership
– Taking responsibility for what we do
Innovation
– Finding smart, practical solutions
Excellence

Team spirit
– Building trust, growth, and enjoyment together

The role

The Brand & Creative Lead is responsible for translating DeltaQuad’s mission, corporate positioning and communication strategy into clear creative direction, concepts, formats and high-quality brand output.

Operating at the intersection of advanced technology, defence and security, you will help shape how DeltaQuad presents its brand, products and capabilities to government and defence customers, international partners, industry stakeholders, investors and other professional audiences.

This is a different creative challenge from traditional consumer or retail branding. Our audiences are highly informed, our products are technically complex and credibility matters. You need to understand what makes a sophisticated product relevant to a B2B audience and turn technical capabilities into communication that is clear, distinctive and compelling without losing substance or accuracy.

You will contribute to the development of our brand strategy and take the lead in bringing that strategy to life creatively. From defining the visual direction for a product launch or industry event to improving our brand templates or briefing a freelance designer, you make sure our creative output is distinctive, consistent, credible and professionally executed.

This is a hands-on creative role, combining strategic and conceptual thinking with practical execution and creative production leadership.

Brand Strategy & Direction:
Help develop our brand strategy and translate our mission, positioning and messaging into clear and distinctive creative direction.
Creative Concepts & Execution:
Develop concepts, formats and assets for campaigns, product launches, market entries, industry events and employer branding.
Brand Consistency:
Own and strengthen brand consistency across our marketing and communication channels.
Product Storytelling:
Work with Product and technical teams to understand complex technology and turn technical capabilities, features and use cases into clear, accurate and visually compelling stories for specialist and B2B audiences.
Creative Leadership:
Brief and guide freelance designers, agencies and other creative partners while remaining hands-on where needed.
Creative Operations:
Improve guidelines, templates, workflows and production processes to raise quality and make creative output more scalable.

What you bring

B2B Brand & Creative Experience:
Strong experience in branding, creative direction or visual communication within a B2B environment. You understand how to communicate to professional audiences and decision-makers, where credibility, clarity and substance are central to the brand.
Technology or Industry Experience:
Experience working with technology, engineering, aerospace, defence, robotics, industrial products or another complex technical offering is strongly preferred. You should be comfortable getting into the detail of a product to understand what you are communicating.
Strong Portfolio:
A portfolio demonstrating strong brand thinking and creative concepts within a B2B, technology or product-led environment, and their consistent application across different formats and channels.
Technical Storytelling:
You can take complex technical information and turn it into communication that is understandable and engaging while retaining the accuracy and substance expected by knowledgeable audiences.
Strategic + Hands-on:
Able to translate brand and communication strategy into creative work and comfortable executing ideas yourself.
Creative Leadership:
Experience directing designers, freelancers, agencies or other creative specialists.
Stakeholder Skills:
Able to work effectively with Product, Marketing, Engineering and other technical stakeholders and turn complex input into strong creative output.
Quality & Ownership:
A sharp eye for detail, high creative standards and the ability to manage multiple projects from concept through delivery.
Professional fluency in English is required.

Who you are

You have a strong creative point of view without becoming precious about your ideas. You can explain why something works, challenge work that isn’t strong enough and translate feedback from different stakeholders into a better creative outcome.

You’re comfortable working in an environment where not everything is already defined. Rather than simply maintaining an established brand system, you enjoy helping build and improve one.
You are genuinely interested in technology and complex products. You don’t need to be an engineer, but you are curious enough to ask the right questions, understand what makes a product technically and commercially relevant and turn that into a strong story.\

You understand that B2B technology branding requires a different approach from consumer branding. The audience may include engineers, defence professionals, government stakeholders, procurement teams, partners and other industry specialists. You know how to create work that gets their attention while still feeling credible, intelligent and appropriate for the environment we’re operating in.

You bring sound judgement about how to present complex information, balancing creative ambition with technical accuracy, audience expectations and organisational sensitivities.

Briefly about ourselves

Random is an experience design studio based in Amsterdam and Paris. Our work comes to life where the digital and the physical are fluid. We use technology in a human, tangible way and so invite people to connect to each other and the space they share.

What we're looking for

We're looking for a Senior Creative Lead who starts with the big question.

Before the space, before the technology, before any of it: what is this experience actually saying? What does this brand need to communicate, and what's the most compelling way to do that in a room, at an event, in a space someone walks into?

That's where this role begins. With a holistic communication concept a brand storytelling idea that gives a project its reason for being. From there, it translates into spatial decisions, interactive moments, technology choices. But those come second. The person we're looking for holds the full arc, from the strategic question down to the specific expression of it.

We would like you to think from brand strategy to communication to experiential execution. In practice, that means someone like this might challenge a client's underlying ambition, build a creative communication strategy for a launch, and define a high-level concept for how a space should behave all within the same project.

If your strongest work is brand campaign films or advertising concepts, this isn't the right role. If your interest lies in creating (spatial) brand experiences where you make people feel something, invite them to explore, make them wonder, then please read on.

Core responsibilities

Concept development: Lead the creative thinking on key projects from brief to concept. Write clear, strong debriefs that sharpen the question before anyone starts answering it. Develop brand storytelling ideas that are holistic not just a visual style, or just a content format, but an idea about what a brand experience should do and feel like and mean.

Creative direction across projects Translate concepts into creative direction for multi-disciplinary teams, spatial designers, creative technologists, motion designers, producers. Not by designing everything yourself, but by making sure the idea holds across every decision.

Client relationships Be the main creative voice with clients throughout a project. Present with clarity and conviction. Challenge briefs when they need challenging. Help clients understand the difference between an installation and an experience.

Team leadership Build and lead project teams, internal and freelance. Set creative standards, give useful feedback, create space for others to do good work. Lead by being present, specific and engaged —not a distant creative director.

New business contribution Contribute to pitches and proposals. Bring ideas to the table early in the process, when the thinking matters most.

What a concept means for us

We've learned to be specific about this because the word gets used to mean too many things.

A Concept In This Context Is Not

A sketch or a render
A visual identity direction
A campaign format or content type
A technology idea

A concept is a brand storytelling idea. It's the answer to the question: what is this experience about? The why. It can usually be expressed in a sentence or two. It generates decisions — about space, interaction, content, materiality, technology — rather than describing them.

The technology is a tool. The space is a medium. The concept is the reason any of it exists.

Your profile

8+ years of experience in creative roles within experiential, brand, or spatial work
A portfolio of idea-led projects where you can clearly articulate what the concept was, where it came from, and how it shaped the final work
Experience working across disciplines: spatial, digital, interactive, content
Comfortable at the strategic level able to read and challenge a brand brief, not just respond to it
Strong presenter and communicator, in rooms that matter
Experience leading teams and working with freelancers
Has worked with global brands in lifestyle, fashion, luxury, or sport
Based in or willing to relocate to Amsterdam or Paris

What we don't need more of

We've had talented people apply whose work is genuinely strong but in a different domain. To save everyone time:

This role is not well suited to people whose primary experience is in advertising, brand film, or content production. The thinking that makes someone good at a 30-second spot or a social campaign is different from what this role requires. Neither is better, they're just different.

What's missing, and what we're looking for, is someone who starts with an idea.

What success looks like

You bring a clear concept to every project, early one that the whole team can work from
Clients trust your creative judgment, not just your execution
The work feels like it has a point of view, not just a visual language
Teams you lead know what they're aiming at and why
You make the projects harder in the right ways, and easier in the wrong ones

In this role, you will work closely with account directors, strategists, designers, writers and analysts to ensure that we’re delivering innovative, beautiful and flawless work that exceeds the expectations of the organisations we work with. You will bring creative vision and impactful leadership to nonprofits, advocacy campaigns and brands’ social impact teams.

We believe great creative is data and strategy driven, not ego-driven. We’re looking for you to collaborate closely with our teams to shape test-worthy ideas that will let the numbers do the talking.

We’re interested in the originality, honesty and proven success of your concepts and appeals.

The company

Blue State is a purpose-driven agency. We partner with leading causes, brands, and campaigns and create real change. From AARP and Doctors Without Borders to Amnesty International and Oxfam, we transform how brands and causes raise money, influence policy, build platforms, and grow communities of supporters. Led by the most creative and analytical minds from the political, nonprofit, and brand worlds, Blue State is an independent agency in the US and London.

A day in the life

Lead and inspire:
Working closely with your colleagues, you’ll develop a vision for our client’s creative success. You’ll guide the development and implementation of campaigns, appeals and creative platforms, from initial presentations through final delivery.
Create with purpose:
Organisations come to us with big questions and for direction on how to be more meaningful, relevant and human - your conceptual thinking and messaging will help make that a reality.
Accountability:
Assess and ensure the quality of creative process and product on an ongoing basis. Attend internal critiques, and provide creative solutions to team. Final sign-off on design, copy, and UX work for key projects.
Foster a culture of collaboration and creativity:
Stay on top of developments in the field, industry, and culture. Help identify, hire and retain designers, copywriters, and other creatives. Mentor junior members of the project team.

Some things we're looking for

6+ years in senior creative role, ideally with hands-on designing experience. At least some of this experience working on fundraising and mobilisation campaigns.
Experience in leading and collaborating with teams of designers, copywriters, strategists and creatives - taking insight that has been shaped and developing compelling, digitally-driven ideas and products.
Strategy-led: able to clearly articulate design or strategy related dilemmas, and offer multiple solutions with a clear link back to the strategy and insights.
Comfort and passion for creative testing, co-creation with clients and audiences, and constructively consolidating feedback from global stakeholders to improve the work.
Impeccable presentation skills: able to explain the reasons behind a particular design or creative strategy, and guide clients through difficult decision points. Experience in pitching a strong advantage.
Deep knowledge of persuasion strategies & tools: copywriting, social influence, brand advocacy, fundraising, UX and experience design.
Strong sense of communications and its operating model: how impactful messages are created, journeys constructed and users driven on a journey from awareness to advocacy.
An area of expertise or passion in the design world (be it fundraising, design, UX, communications or social change) that you can harness and upskill wider team members with as a thought leader within the wider company.
Industry-leading quality of work: you produce inspiring work that stands out, is flawless in execution, and innovative in thought. You are both a doer and a thinker, and your work reflects that.
Patient with your colleagues and clients, able to make key decisions when and where required.
Ability to adapt to new situations, solve problems on the fly, and communicate with those around you. Teamwork and scrappiness required, alongside respect to our clients and their expertise.
A shared passion and curiosity for making change. This includes comfort with ambiguity, a restlessness that resists the status quo, and a commitment to quality that ensures we’re always making progress.
A firm grasp on the latest AI tools, the creative and ethical considerations they demand, and a healthy disrelish for written and visual slop.
Empathy, communication, respect, and the ability to act as a role model at Blue State.
